source.path: Nintendo Entertainment System/Castlevania II_ Simon_s Quest.pdf

evidence.Default/Up: pdf4 (printed 6): Control Pad - "Press Up or Down to go up and down stairs... When in front of a door, press Up to go inside."
evidence.Default/Down: pdf4 (printed 6): Control Pad - "Press Up or Down to go up and down stairs... To squat and avoid enemy projectiles, simply press Down."
evidence.Default/Left/Right: pdf4 (printed 6): Control Pad - "Press Left or Right to go to the left or right."
evidence.Default/A: pdf4 (printed 6): leader line to the right round button, A Button - "Press A Button to jump."
evidence.Default/B: pdf4 (printed 6): leader line to the left round button, B Button - "Press B Button to lash with a whip... Also press B Button to talk with the friendly Transylvanian villagers and merchants."
evidence.Default/A+B: pdf4 (printed 6): B Button - "If you press B Button and A Button simultaneously, you can jump and lash with a whip at the same time."
evidence.Default/Up+B: pdf4 (printed 6): How to Use Certain Weapons - "Press Up on the Control Pad while pressing B Button to throw the Holy Water or Dagger, drive in the Oak Stake, use the Flame, place the Garlic in strategic locations, etc."
evidence.Default/Select: pdf4 (printed 6): leader line to the left oval, Select Button - "Press the Select Button during the game to pause."
evidence.Default/Start: pdf4 (printed 6): leader line to the right oval, Start Button - "Press the Start Button to begin the game. Press during the middle of the game to display a Multi Screen, which gives you the option to choose from weapons and magical items."
